translation: Moreover, wherever the bones of the whole body fork into two, they are all called qigu (岐骨); the student should know this. <ins>Jiajian Suzi Taoren Tang</ins> (Modified Perilla-Seed and Peach-Kernel Decoction, 加減蘇子桃仁湯) (seen in the injury of the vertex bone) <ins>Shuxue Wan</ins> (Blood-Dispersing Pill, 疏血丸) (seen in the injury of the lingyun bone) <ins>Wanling Gao</ins> (Myriad-Efficacy Plaster, 萬靈膏) (seen in the injury of the vertex bone) <ins>Dingtong San</ins> (Pain-Relieving Powder, 定痛散) (seen in the injury of the shanjiao bone).
